title: Brancaleone alle Crociate
writer: Agenore Incrocci, Furio Scarpelli, Mario Monicelli
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Adolfo Celi, Sandro Dori
plot: After saving an infant of royal blood, knight Brancaleone forms a new army and sets out to return the baby to his father: a prince fighting in the Crusades.
